threads.title: Whatever the switch opened and what screams
threads.detail: Llyr found a hidden switch behind Shar's statue; a grating sound opened something to the right with inhuman screaming.
threads.how: Llyr's switch and the screaming were tied to Massatar's study and the cell beyond it, though the screaming itself was never explained.
threads.quip: The screaming was the only thing in Candlekeep louder than Llyr's stories about his children.

threads.title: The zombie teen and the low-voiced thing in the chasm
threads.detail: The teen, risen from the boy's corpse, grew five heads and survived the fall, screaming. Something low-voiced is down there with him.

threads.title: Disarming the obelisk trap
threads.detail: The jet-black obelisks electrify anything passing between them. Catches under each can move, but nobody knows how to turn them off. Sykth is working on it.

threads.title: Massatar and the Sanguine Vessel
threads.detail: The dwarf keeper and the Sanguine Vessel are still missing. Garstang's audience depends on finding them under the deal with the Baldur's Gate official.

threads.title: Shar worship and Metheran's phylactery
threads.detail: The house's owner worshipped Shar, as does Metheran the lich. Is there a link to the phylactery the party is hunting?

threads.title: The Hollow Saint and Massatar's cabal
threads.detail: Massatar's unsent letter says the Hollow Saint may be swayed; Llyr suspects the little girl outside is her. Massatar may already be in Baldur's Gate.

threads.title: Garstang's stock and the black wine insignia
threads.detail: Massatar calls Garstang's supplier 'stock' and Dera overcharged for black wine. The wax insignia on the bottles is still unidentified.

threads.title: Shar dagger and the two unread scrolls
threads.detail: The obsidian dagger bears Shar's sigil, and two scrolls in wax cylinders remain unread. Necrotic Nights is a suspected dud.

threads.title: The devil with the keys and its doors
threads.detail: A bored six-armed devil is still stuck in a room of doors, now without Moonbeam pressure and no longer charmed. Its purpose is unknown.
